column1: #mapping_set_description: RefgetStore build table (refgenie-registry stores/<store>/sources.csv), validated by stores/sources_schema.json. One row per FASTA (or space-separated FASTAs concatenated) to load into a store; each row becomes one sequence collection. Columns beyond the schema's are allowed and differ by store.

column9: Lossy: May hold several space-separated URLs that are concatenated into one collection; kept as one string.
Lossy: Sometimes includes the strain (Saccharomyces cerevisiae strain S288C).
Lossy: Mixes assembly names (GRCh38), UCSC names (hg38) and iGenomes labels; kept as a label.
Value transformed (accession). Lossy: A claim checked against NCBI by build_aliases, not a verified fact.
Folder-like label for organizing a store.
Sample name in the PEP the row came from (some stores only).
A legacy Salmon index hash, not a FASTA checksum.
Population of the HPRC sample (pangenome store only); no core field.
